fields.name: apiBaseUrl
fields.label: API Base URL
fields.description: Backend API origin. Filled automatically when the page is generated from a resource.

fields.name: slug
fields.label: Primary Resource Slug
fields.description: Slug of the resource this landing page belongs to. Filled automatically.

fields.name: gated
fields.label: Gating status (set by the backend; display only)
fields.description: This is a status display, not a setting. Picking a different option here does nothing: the backend decides gating from where each file is stored, and rewrites this field on its next sync. A file in the private S3 bucket is gated (registration required). A file in the AEM DAM is always open. To gate a file, use 'Upload gated download' in the editor toolbar above this block.

fields.name: itemTitle
fields.label: Title
fields.description: Display title for this download. Falls back to the resource title or file name.

fields.name: itemDescription
fields.label: Description
fields.description: Supporting copy. On Feature cards this doubles as the 'what's inside' line.

fields.name: buttonLabel
fields.label: Button Label
fields.description: Defaults by file type (Download PDF, Download PowerPoint, Watch Video...).

fields.name: file
fields.label: File
fields.description: Pick or upload a DAM file (PDF, Word, PowerPoint, ZIP, MP4). On the next resource sync, this becomes a tracked file on the current resource page - no slug needed.

fields.name: filePath
fields.label: File Path (Manual)
fields.description: Paste the DAM path here if the picker does not open the expected folder or the file still needs to be uploaded first. Example: /content/dam/edge/misc/PDFs/example.pdf. Overrides the picker value.

fields.name: resourceSlug
fields.label: Resource Slug (existing resource)
fields.description: Only for linking an EXISTING backend resource by slug — pulls its title, file, thumbnail, and gating. Filled automatically for file items once they sync.

fields.name: image
fields.label: Image / Poster
fields.description: Thumbnail for Document cards or poster for Video items. Optional — a card with no picture shows colour-coded art for the file type instead. This is per download; the resource's own thumbnail is the image on its library card, and is no longer repeated onto every download here.

fields.name: videoUrl
fields.label: Video URL
fields.description: YouTube, Vimeo, or MP4 URL for Video items. Slug-backed items fall back to the resource's video.

fields.name: displayStyle
fields.label: Display Style
fields.description: Horizontal: image on the left, title, description, audience/format/time and the button on the right, always a full row. Tile: image on top with the file type and length, in rows of up to four. When the block's FIRST download is a Tile it is shown as a Horizontal card across the top, with the tiles below it.

options.name: Tile (image on top, rows of tiles)

fields.name: gated
fields.label: Gating status (set by the backend; display only)
fields.description: This is a status display, not a setting. Picking a different option here does nothing: the card shows a lock only when the backend says this file is gated, and that is decided by where the file is stored. A file in the private S3 bucket is gated (registration required). A file picked from the AEM DAM is always open and cannot be gated, because AEM makes it public as soon as the page is published. To gate a file, use 'Upload gated download' in the editor toolbar above this block.

fields.name: informativeAudienceLabel
fields.label: Audience Label Override
fields.description: Optional label for the audience detail on Horizontal and Informative cards. Defaults to Audience.

fields.name: informativeAudienceText
fields.label: Audience Override
fields.description: Optional audience text for Horizontal and Informative cards. Falls back to the resource audience tags; hidden when there are none.

fields.name: informativeFormatLabel
fields.label: Format Label Override
fields.description: Optional label for the format detail on Horizontal and Informative cards. Defaults to Format.

fields.name: informativeFormatText
fields.label: Format Override
fields.description: Optional format text for Horizontal and Informative cards. Falls back to PDF, Video, PowerPoint, bundle, or the resource type.

fields.name: informativeTimeLabel
fields.label: Time Label Override
fields.description: Optional label for the time detail on Horizontal and Informative cards. Defaults to Time.

fields.name: informativeTimeText
fields.label: Time Override
fields.description: Optional length, e.g. 30 minutes. Used by Horizontal, Tile and Informative cards (a Tile shortens it to 30M). Falls back to the resource length; hidden when there is none.
